## Message

```
error X18N4004: Plan is stale: <detail>
  Files changed since the plan was made. Plan again.
```

The CLI prints the code, the message and a detail, such as a file name or a field. The hint follows on the next line. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

A file changed after x18n made the plan, so x18n did not write anything. For `x18n extract --apply`, the source file changed after you wrote the plan file.

1. Run the command again. x18n makes a new plan from the current files.
2. For extraction, run `x18n extract --plan <file>` again and edit the new plan.

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `4`.
